objectives.description: Add section_i following Section G/H's fixture idiom, register in main()/header
Build a small real fixture .literature.db with a matching fixture index.json
Case I1: long multi-word query with literal <sec:representation> returns non-empty
Case I2: sparse honesty at exact threshold boundary (both sides)
Case I3: error isolation (all-hostile vs mixed)
Case I4: dedupe (chunk matched by 2 terms counted once)
Confirm each case fails against stashed pre-fix scripts

approaches_tried.approach: Case I4 using a single-term query ("representation") to test dedupe
approaches_tried.reason: A single-term query cannot exercise cross-term merge dedup at all (a single MATCH naturally returns each row once); it produced identical seg_count=3 pre- and post-fix, proving nothing. Replaced with a two-term query ("representation duality") where one chunk (i_c4) satisfies BOTH terms individually -- pre-fix AND-all-terms only returns that one chunk (seg_count=1), post-fix per-term merge returns all 3 with i_c4 counted exactly once (seg_count=3), giving a real pre/post distinction.
